findings.title: The matrix that replaces test_pr is scoped to pull requests and pushes, but required-checks-pr also runs on merge_group
findings.recommendation: ci.yml triggers on merge_group, and test_pr, validate-changesets and required-checks-pr all run when the event is pull_request or merge_group. Walk entry F1 folds test_pr into the matrix and has required-checks-pr need test_matrix, but D2, the CI requirement ("for every pull request and every push to main") and task 2.1 name only pull_request and push. An implementation built to that text gives test_matrix an `if` of push or pull_request; on a merge_group run test_matrix is then skipped and required-checks-pr, which fails any result other than success, goes red. Name merge_group beside pull_request in D2, task 2.1 and the CI requirement (the matrix runs on every event required-checks-pr runs on), or drop the merge_group trigger and say so.

findings.title: The proposal's What Changes still says the source-lint paragraph now points at the history file
findings.recommendation: Walk entry F4 re-pointed the source-lint paragraph's example to an architecture doc's status log and re-wrote the Modified Capabilities bullet, but proposal.md:35-37's What Changes bullet still reads 'Its paragraph naming `CLAUDE.md` as the standing example of narrated history now points at the history file.' The sweep retired a different phrasing, so this one survived. An implementer reading the proposal first would write the rejected example into the spec. Re-word the bullet to the delta's text: the example becomes an architecture doc's status log, and a record kept in the domain is read but inert while unmarked.

walk_entry.title: The delta's standing example of a living file that narrates history is a record with no present-tense claim

findings.title: R-ugd-12 entered the rulings index with no status-log entry
findings.recommendation: R-ugd-11 has a dated status-log entry recording its capture ('R-ugd-11 captured (Sal), in an architect session'); R-ugd-12, written into the index at the proposal walk, has none, so the doc's append-only narrative does not say when or where the third carve-out from R-ugd-3 was taken. Append a one-paragraph status-log entry naming the walk and Sal's 'A'.

commentary: Graded the two walks' thirteen resolved entries over each entry's file, cascade and sweep scope, then ran a residual diff from the commit that added the external return: every file the walks touched sits in some entry's edit record. Both regressions are completeness misses in a walk's own cascade, not defects in the reviewed mechanism: one fix replaced a job without carrying every event the replaced job ran on, and one sweep retired one phrasing of a claim while a second phrasing of the same claim stood in the proposal. The scan requirement's rewrite reads cleanly against both reviewers' findings, and the three converged stale calls are correct.
